mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_gigab2b_product_list l INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, sku, product_name, sync_time, price, exclusive_price, discounted_price, currency, seller_available_inventory, buyer_available_inventory, sku_available, detail_json, price_json, inventory_json FROM ( SELECT s1.id, s1.sku, s1.product_name, s1.sync_time, s1.price, s1.exclusive_price, s1.discounted_price, s1.currency, s1.seller_available_inventory, s1.buyer_available_inventory, s1.sku_available, s1.detail_json, s1.price_json, s1.inventory_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s1.sku ORDER BY (CASE WHEN IFNULL(s1.price,0) > 0 OR IFNULL(s1.discounted_price,0) > 0 OR IFNULL(s1.exclusive_price,0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN s1.price_json IS NOT NULL AND s1.price_json NOT IN ('', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, s1.sync_time DESC, s1.id DESC ) AS rn FROM t_gigab2b_product_snapshot s1 WHERE s1.sku = (SELECT sku FROM t_gigab2b_product_list WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1) ) sx WHERE sx.rn = 1 ) s ON s.sku = l.sku WHERE l.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM t_gigab2b_product_list l INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, sku, product_name, sync_time, price, exclusive_price, discounted_price, currency, seller_available_inventory, buyer_available_inventory, sku_available, detail_json, price_json, inventory_json FROM ( SELECT s1.id, s1.sku, s1.product_name, s1.sync_time, s1.price, s1.exclusive_price, s1.discounted_price, s1.currency, s1.seller_available_inventory, s1.buyer_available_inventory, s1.sku_available, s1.detail_json, s1.price_json, s1.inventory_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s1.sku ORDER BY (CASE WHEN IFNULL(s1.price,0) > 0 OR IFNULL(s1.discounted_price,0) > 0 OR IFNULL(s1.exclusive_price,0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN s1.price_json IS NOT NULL AND s1.price_json NOT IN ('', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, s1.sync_time DESC, s1.id DESC ) AS rn FROM t_gigab2b_product_snapshot s1 WHERE s1.sku = #{sku} ) sx WHERE sx.rn = 1 ) s ON s.sku = l.sku WHERE l.sku = #{sku} ORDER BY l.sync_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1
